fix:R-W04-ci.root_cause:
(1) The four harness nodes had a stale module binding (issue #185 class):
- tests/test_platform_router.py::test_does_not_import_price_service (lines 321-328) deletes every price_service entry from sys.modules and never restores them. The next import therefore builds a FRESH module object.
- tests/test_verify_flag_byte_identity.py bound `from app.services import price_service as ps` at collection time (line 168). `_install_env_spy` then patched `ps.extract_price_from_html` on that old module.
- scripts/verify_flag_byte_identity.py imports `from app.services.price_service import extract_price_from_html` inside the sweep at call time (line 258). After the deletion that import resolves to the fresh module, so the harness ran the real extractor and the spy recorded 0 of 8 calls.
- When the file runs alone, both names point to the same object, which is why local runs passed.

(2) The retro node timed out; the cause is test cost, not order:
- It runs about 1,300 real `extract_price_from_html` calls, roughly 125M Python calls. That count was measured identical across orders.
- CI runs the whole free tier under `--cov=app` with `--timeout=60`. Coverage tracing brings the node to 47-52 s on the dev box, and the CI runner went past 60 s.
- Its spy target, `bs4.BeautifulSoup.__init__`, is already the class the live extraction uses, so the spy needed no change.

fix:R-W04-ci.pr_text:
CI hermeticity note (#185 class). The first CI run of this PR failed backend-tests (5 failed / 18,820 passed). These are test-harness problems in the one-process suite; no product defect was involved, and the app/ and scripts/ bytes did not change (`git diff -- app scripts` is empty). There were two separate causes.

(1) Four TestW04HarnessFlagsOnAndCompare nodes. tests/test_platform_router.py::test_does_not_import_price_service deletes every price_service entry from sys.modules and never restores them. tests/test_verify_flag_byte_identity.py had bound `price_service as ps` at collection time and put its env spy on that old object. scripts/verify_flag_byte_identity.py imports extract_price_from_html inside the call, so after the deletion it ran the fresh module and the spy saw 0 of 8 calls. The test now resolves the live module at patch time (`importlib.import_module`, the object main() will read). Reproduction: platform_router placed before the harness file gives 4 failed; with the fix it gives 434 passed. A mutant that restores the collection-time binding fails the same 4 again.

(2) tests/test_retro_w0_4.py::test_flag_on_extraction_is_identical_over_every_fixture_page. This was a timeout, not an assertion failure. It runs about 1,300 real extractions under `--cov=app`: 47-52 s alone on the dev box, and past the 60 s per-test budget on the CI runner. cProfile shows the same about 125M calls alone and after every CI-order prefix tested, so the cost does not depend on test order. It now carries `@pytest.mark.timeout(600)`, following the precedent in tests/test_retro_w1_1.py, and every assertion is unchanged.
